model.stratum: Forward realization, attachment transport and route compatibility of retained five-coordinate construction maps on locally generated primitive honeycomb cells; nine source operations, every operation occurrence counted, no target-composition filter. Configuration graph retains complete histories as labelled words, not identified histories.
consumes: Common local geometry and full-five-slot transfer laws
provides: Generated configurations and connections without isotope blueprints
All compatible continuations from all retained construction records
Pending-contact and entry/exit certificates distinct from geometric adjacency
missing_constructors: Physical interpretation of retained branching construction maps
Parallel or collective operation permitting many new bodies per stage
model.next_falsifier: An independently enumerated short construction word is omitted, a target-composition/layout import enters the generator, an incompatible field/role contact passes, or a resource-limited run is reported as a complete nine-stage search.
